## 0.1.0-beta.25

- Plex now uses the MisterZine Plex Core logotype in Zaparoo Frontend, including existing pinned tiles. Menu positions, custom icons and custom names are preserved. Restart Frontend after updating to see the artwork.
- Improved diagnostics when the SD card cannot save a report, with clearer failure messages and more storage information for troubleshooting.

Existing beta access codes continue to work.
